en.t: Suddenly, he could not run anymore.

units.source_text: 脚上这份重量，可不寻常。

en.t: The weight dragging at his legs was no ordinary heaviness.

units.source_text: 不仅有这种感觉，而且，脚下真的开始泥泞起来。

en.t: It was not just a sensation; the ground under his feet had truly begun to turn muddy.

units.source_text: 待他觉得像踩在雪地上一样的时候，小腿的一半已经陷进去了。

en.t: By the time it felt as if he were stepping through snow, half of his lower legs had already sunk in.

units.source_text: 他吓了一跳，赶忙提腿，谁知另外一条腿挣扎使劲，这回扑哧扑哧竟淹没到了膝盖。

en.t: Startled, he hurriedly tried to lift one leg, but the other leg strained and struggled, and this time it sank with a squelching sound all the way to the knee.

units.source_text: 曾听说过有“食人沙”之类的东西……

en.t: He had heard of things like man-eating sand...

units.source_text: 他挣扎着，试图摆脱，谁知越是挣扎越是陷得深。

en.t: He struggled and tried to break free, but the more he struggled, the deeper he sank.

units.source_text: 两脚已经埋到大腿根部了。

en.t: Both legs were already buried up to the tops of his thighs.
